import json, urllib.request

BASE = 'https://api.ivxholding.com'

# 1. Get fresh emergency token
h = {'Content-Type': 'application/json'}
d = json.dumps({'email': 'iperez4242@gmail.com', 'emergency': 'ivx_emergency_recovery'}).encode()
req = urllib.request.Request(f'{BASE}/api/ivx/owner-passwordless-login', data=d, headers=h, method='POST')
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=25) as r:
        data = json.loads(r.read())
        if data.get('success'):
            token = data.get('accessToken','')
            with open('/tmp/owner_token.txt', 'w') as f:
                f.write(token)
            print(f'Token OK ({len(token)} chars)')
        else:
            print(f'FAILED: {data.get("message","?")}')
            exit(1)
except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
    print(f'HTTP {e.code}: {e.read().decode()[:200]}')
    exit(1)

TOKEN = open('/tmp/owner_token.txt').read().strip()
h2 = {'Content-Type': 'application/json', 'Authorization': f'Bearer {TOKEN}'}

# 2. Commit the orchestrator change to GitHub
print("\n=== COMMITTING ORCHESTRATOR FIX ===")
GITHUB_TOKEN = "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"
REPO = "ibb142/rork-global-real-estate-invest"
BRANCH = "main"

def gh(method, path, body=None):
    url = f"https://api.github.com/repos/{REPO}/{path}"
    data = json.dumps(body).encode() if body else None
    req = urllib.request.Request(url, data=data, method=method, headers={
        "Authorization": f"token {GITHUB_TOKEN}",
        "Accept": "application/vnd.github+json",
        "Content-Type": "application/json",
    })
    try:
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=30) as r:
            return json.loads(r.read())
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(f"  GH ERROR {e.code}: {e.read().decode()[:300]}")
        return None

head = gh("GET", f"git/refs/heads/{BRANCH}")
head_sha = head["object"]["sha"] if head else ""
print(f"  Current HEAD: {head_sha[:12]}")

base_commit = gh("GET", f"git/commits/{head_sha}")
base_tree_sha = base_commit["tree"]["sha"] if base_commit else ""

with open("backend/services/ivx-registration-orchestrator.ts", "rb") as f:
    content = f.read()

blob = gh("POST", "git/blobs", {"content": content.decode(), "encoding": "utf-8"})
blob_sha = blob["sha"] if blob else ""

tree = gh("POST", "git/trees", {"base_tree": base_tree_sha, "tree": [{"path": "backend/services/ivx-registration-orchestrator.ts", "mode": "100644", "type": "blob", "sha": blob_sha}]})
tree_sha = tree["sha"] if tree else ""

commit = gh("POST", "git/commits", {
    "message": "IVX AUTH P0: Add role-specific record creation to registration orchestrator\n\nRegistration now inserts into role-specific tables based on selected roles:\n- investor → investors\n- buyer → buyers\n- jv_partner → jv_partners\n- broker → brokers\n- agent → agents\n- land_owner → land_owners\n- tokenized → tokenized_investors\n\nNon-fatal: errors logged but don't block registration completion.",
    "tree": tree_sha,
    "parents": [head_sha],
})
commit_sha = commit["sha"] if commit else ""
print(f"  New commit: {commit_sha[:12]}")

ref = gh("PATCH", f"git/refs/heads/{BRANCH}", {"sha": commit_sha, "force": False})
if ref:
    print(f"  Ref updated: {ref['object']['sha'][:12]}")

# 3. Trigger Render deploy
print("\n=== TRIGGERING RENDER DEPLOY ===")
d2 = json.dumps({'action': 'render_trigger_deploy', 'confirm': True, 'confirmText': 'CONFIRM_IVX_RENDER_DEPLOY'}).encode()
req2 = urllib.request.Request(f'{BASE}/api/ivx/developer-deploy/action', data=d2, headers=h2, method='POST')
try:
    with urllib.request.urlopen(req2, timeout=30) as r2:
        print(f"  Deploy: {json.loads(r2.read()).get('result',{}).get('status','?')}")
except Exception as e:
    print(f"  Deploy: {e}")

# 4. Wait for deploy
print("\n=== WAITING FOR RENDER DEPLOY ===")
import time
for i in range(18):
    time.sleep(10)
    try:
        req3 = urllib.request.Request(f'{BASE}/api/ivx/version')
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req3, timeout=10) as r3:
            ver = json.loads(r3.read())
            c = ver.get('commitShort','?')[:12]
            print(f"  {i+1}: {c}")
            if c == commit_sha[:12]:
                print(f"  DEPLOY CONFIRMED: {c}")
                break
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"  {i+1}: {e}")

# 5. Health check
req4 = urllib.request.Request(f'{BASE}/health')
with urllib.request.urlopen(req4, timeout=10) as r4:
    h_data = json.loads(r4.read())
    print(f"  Health: {h_data.get('status')}")
PYEOF
